name: Runner Tests Fixture - Tdd
brief: Proves --tdd (issues #1997/#2001/#5147) generates missing members from usage and infers their type, or refuses rather than guesses; each test that reaches a generated member reports its own result and names the members it reaches.
description: Broken test codeunits covering every inference anchor (assignment-target field, assignment-target/nested-argument/if-condition procedure return type, enum value), a test asserting an empty stub's default return, two refuse cases (bare-statement call, both-sides-unresolved assignment) and one unrelated healthy test codeunit, all in the same bundle. Without --tdd this fixture behaves exactly like EmitExclusionLoudnessTests fixture (exit 3, EMIT-EXCLUDED). With --tdd, generated procedures have an empty body returning the type's default, generated fields and enum values simply exist, and each test reports its own assertion result, annotated with the generated members it reaches; refused cases still report FAILED naming the AL diagnostic; the unrelated healthy test passes unannotated.
